summary: Virtuix Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the exchange of outstanding secured convertible promissory notes held by Streeterville Capital for a new pre-paid purchase agreement. The new instrument has a principal amount of $3,471,923, bears 6% interest, and allows Streeterville to purchase Common Stock at a fixed or market price subject to a 9.99% beneficial ownership cap. This is a routine debt restructuring/refinancing, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is involved.
